items.summary: I've played this game since back in 2025. I'd give it 10 stars if I could, I love this game and I love the devs. I'm so happy this game is still running, the devs are extremely generous. the story is amazing, the character design is beautiful. I wish this gem many more years of life

items.summary: This is such a fun and unique game for its interesting plot and pretty characters!! My favourite game so far. The gameplay style is fun too. Again and again I am absolute amazed by all of the designs especially with 24, Xu, and many more (all of their designs is to die for). I could ramble about this game all day and night. Saying this as someone who got easily bored with any other games.
